tools.name: brazil_yield_curve
tools.description:
Nominal Brazilian sovereign zero-coupon curve, bootstrapped from
    Tesouro Direto LTN (zero-coupon) and NTN-F (semi-annual coupon)
    offered-security quotes (method_id sovereign_zero_curve_bootstrap_v1).

    institutional ANB
